category: OCR and document parsing API, paid with a testing credit

free_tier.stated: no free tier and no free trial for the OCR API: a one-time USD 19.99 non-refundable setup fee activates the first API key and applies a USD 29 testing credit to the account; a credit or debit card is required to activate a key. Billing is per use after the credit: image OCR USD 0.002 per image, documents (PDF, DOCX, PPTX) USD 0.005 per page, batch documents USD 0.0015 per page
free_tier.notes: the testing credit is denominated in USD (USD 29); the metered unit is images for v3/text and pages for v3/pdf and the Files API, for which the vocabulary has no term

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-file size or per-document page cap read on the pricing, billing or limits pages; the Files API accepts a job of up to 200,000 documents

retention.stated: images are stored for quality assurance for 30 days by default; a retention opt-out deletes images within 24 hours

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published; the Files API can write results to a customer-owned S3, GCS or Azure bucket

interface_detail: REST endpoints v3/text (image), v3/pdf (documents), v3/strokes (digital ink) and files/v1 (asynchronous batch); the open-source Mathpix CLI (mpx) drives the hosted API
tooling: any HTTP client with app_id and app_key headers; the Mathpix CLI (mpx) handles uploads, status polling and downloads
chaining: a paid OCR lane for printed and handwritten STEM content (math, tables, chemistry diagrams); the USD 29 testing credit costs a USD 19.99 setup fee and a card, so the no-card hosted OCR offers come before it

limits.value: USD 29 testing credit applied after the one-time USD 19.99 setup fee; the default page limit is 20,000 pages per month for v3/pdf and files/v1 together, per API key
200 requests per minute per API key on synchronous image requests (v3/text, v3/latex); asynchronous and batch requests are not subject to the per-minute limit

identity_cost.detail: a Mathpix account with a verified email, then an API organization on the Pay as you go plan with a credit or debit card added and a one-time non-refundable setup fee paid before a key is issued

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded; the page limit and rate limit are per key and can be raised from the console Requests tab
confidence_note: the card requirement, the setup fee, the testing credit, the prices and the default limits are quoted from vendor pages read on 2026-11-03; no request was made, because a key needs a paid setup. The per-file size cap is unverified.
